circle.data-tooltip-text: duo acquires ownership of a resource
duo's resource is moved
duo goes out of scope. No resource is dropped.
d acquires ownership of a resource

g.data-tooltip-text:
• d's resource is immutably borrowed by println!; d is read-only while the borrow is live
• println! reads from d through an implicit reference, so d isn't moved
• d's resource is no longer immutably borrowed
d goes out of scope. Its resource is dropped.

polygon.style: fill: var(--rv-drop-notch); stroke: none; pointer-events: none;

• println! reads from e through an implicit reference, so e isn't moved
• e's resource is no longer immutably borrowed
